description.value: The Village is the Royal Oak location of a local brunch franchise that has been voted Best Breakfast in the City three years running. It serves a locally inspired menu alongside directly traded and locally roasted coffee in a dining room and on a patio. Located just off the Pat Bay Highway, it offers both sit-down service and take-out packaged intentionally for travel.

address.value: 4517 W Saanich Road, Victoria, BC V8Z 3G3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at royaloakvillage.ca confirms this is 'Royal Oak - The Village Restaurant,' an all-day brunch spot at 4517 W Saanich Road, Victoria, BC, with phone 250-883-8194.
